## How Do We Produce Vowels?
*Closeness* (how closed or how open the mouth is)
*Backness* (how far back in the mouth the vowel is articulated)
*Roundedness* (whether the lips are rounded)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Identifying Consonant Sounds
Voicing, Place of articulation, manner of articulation

**Voicing:**
Are the vocal cords vibrating or not? (Place your hand on the throat to find out)
![](data:image/png;base64,)
![](data:image/png;base64,)

**Place of Articulation**
Where in the mouth is the constriction taking place?
![](data:image/png;base64,)

|   |   |   |
|---|---|---|
|Terminology|Definition|Examples|
|bilabial|both lips together|/p/ /b/  /m/|
|labiodental|lips against the teeth|/f/ /v/|
|dental/<br><br>interdental|tongue between the teeth|/θ/ /ð/|
|alveolar|tongue at the alveolar ridge (behind the teeth)|/t/ /d/ /s/ /z/ <br><br>/n/  /ŋ/  /l/  /r/|
|postalveolar|tongue near or touching the back of the alveolar ridge|/ʃ/ /ʒ/ /tʃ/ /dʒ/|
|Terminology|Definition|Examples|
|palatal|the body of the tongue against the hard palate|/j/|
|velar|tongue at the velum (soft palate)|/k/ /g/|
|glottal|using the glottis as their primary articulation|/h/|

**Manner of Articulation:**
How does the air pass through your vocal tract?

|   |   |
|---|---|
|Terminology|Examples|
|plosive/stop|/p/ /b/                        /t/ /d/                /k/ /g/|
|nasal|/m/          /n/    /ŋ/|
|fricative|/f/ /v/        /θ/ /ð/        /s/ /z/        /ʃ/ /ʒ/   /h/|
|affricate|/tʃ/ /dʒ/|
|lateral|/l/        /r/        /ɫ/|
|approximant/glide|/w/            /y/|

## The International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
In the IPA, each letter has one fixed sound value, so you can apply it to more languages.
